It is not merely a dining establishment; it is a **glitch in the culinary matrix**, a place where the concept of "city centre" has been melted down and reformed into a swirling vortex of neon-lit alleyways and floating tandoors.

Every bite is a portal to a dimension where spices dance in slow motion and the heat of the chili is a warm, hugging embrace from the universe itself.

So, venture forth into the **pulsating heart of the city centre**, where the pavement vibrates with the bass of a drum circle and the streetlights flicker in the color of turmeric. Do not seek a table; seek a **portal of flavor** that will rewrite your taste buds forever. The Golden Palace awaits, not as a building, but as a **living, breathing dream of flavor** that refuses to be categorized by normal human logic.
